bull_bear.body:
- Strong long-standing relationships with marquee customers across diverse end-user industries with stringent qualification processes and high repeat-order share (FY25 ~79.78%)
- Export-driven global delivery model (24 countries, ~75% revenue outside India, Houston warehouse)
- Fastest-growing in identified peer set: 92.45% revenue growth FY24-FY25, 39.06% CAGR FY23-FY25 (ICRA)
- Broad certified manufacturing capability (383 CNC machines, in-house special processes, testing centre; ISO/AS9100/IATF/API certifications)
- Large diversified order book of Rs 17,647.84 million as on Sep 30, 2025 (~551% of FY25 product/service revenue)
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Customer concentration — Top 10 customers were 47.87% (FY25) to 68.88% (FY23) of product/service revenue; loss of a key customer would materially hurt results
- Export dependence / currency risk — ~75% of revenue from outside India exposes the company to FX and global demand cycles
- End-market concentration in Energy — Energy is the largest segment (FY25 42.35% of revenue, 74.07% of order book), tying results to oil & gas / power capex cycles
- Execution risk on new-facility capex — Large capex to set up Proposed Facilities 1 & 2 funded from fresh issue; ramp and utilisation are unproven
- Promoter concentration — Promoters hold 93.04% pre-offer; governance dependent on the promoter family
- Third-party industry report reliance — Market data derived from an ICRA report commissioned and paid for by the company
bull_bear.title: Bear — key risks

business.body: Omnitech manufactures highly engineered precision machined components and assemblies (weight 0.003 kg to 503.33 kg, precision up to 5 microns) majorly used in safety-critical applications. With 19 years of experience it supplied over 256 customers across 24 countries during FY23-H1FY26, deriving the majority of revenue from exports (~75%). Products serve Energy (oil & gas, wind, power), Motion Control & Automation, Industrial Equipment Systems and other diversified industrial applications.
business.title: What they do

business.body:
- **Energy:** Drilling, exploration and refining products (upstream/midstream/downstream), Braking systems, drive systems, pumping units for renewable energy and power
- **Motion Control and Automation:** Actuator systems, Motion control and drive technologies, Robotic systems, Conveying and handling systems
- **Industrial Equipment Systems:** Aerospace ground support equipment components, Construction equipment components, Winch and hoist components, Crushing/screening and drilling equipment components
- **Others:** Metal forming and diversified industrial application components
